title: The Moisture Stored Grain Is Run Down To, by Grade Guarantee
content:
The moisture the grain is run down to follows what the elevator has undertaken to give back. This rule governs conditioning on Grain Storage and Conditioning Agreements and turns on the programme's grade guarantee and on whether a receipt has been issued against the agreement.

## Clause

Where the agreement guarantees the grade written on the receipt and a receipt has been issued against the agreement, the grain is run down to the programme's target moisture less the receipt margin of 0.5 of a point, so that it grades through the life of the receipt.

Where the agreement guarantees the lot as it was delivered, the grain is run down to the programme's target moisture less the lot margin of 0.3 of a point.

And otherwise the grain is run down to the programme's target moisture.

## The guarantee and the target by programme

| Programme | Grade guaranteed | Target moisture (percent) |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Open Storage Account | house average grade | 15.0 |
| Grain Bank Deposit Account | house average grade | 15.0 |
| Commercial Warehouse Receipt Storage | receipt grade | 14.5 |
| Seasonal Paid-Up Storage Agreement | receipt grade | 14.5 |
| Conditioned Reserve Storage Agreement | receipt grade | 14.0 |
| Identity Preserved Segregated Storage | delivered lot grade | 13.5 |

## Truth table of the conditions

| Grade guaranteed | A receipt has been issued against the agreement | Run down to |
| --- | --- | --- |
| the grade written on the receipt | yes | the programme's target moisture less 0.5 of a point |
| the grade written on the receipt | no | the programme's target moisture |
| the lot as it was delivered | either way | the programme's target moisture less 0.3 of a point |
| the house average grade | either way | the programme's target moisture |

## Worked targets, on hypothetical agreements

**A Commercial Warehouse Receipt Storage with a receipt issued against it.** The guarantee is the grade written on the receipt and a receipt stands, so the grain is run down to 14.5 percent less 0.5 of a point, which is 14.0 percent.

**The same programme with no receipt ever issued.** Neither of the first two lines is met, so the grain is run down to the programme's target of 14.5 percent.

**An Identity Preserved Segregated Storage.** That programme guarantees the lot as delivered, so the grain is run down to 13.5 percent less 0.3 of a point, which is 13.2 percent, whether or not any receipt stands.
